scenes.head: We only *receive* invoices. No ASP needed?

lines.say: Myth or fact? If we only receive invoices, we don't need an A.S.P.

scenes.fact: Issuer *and* recipient each work through their appointed ASP.
scenes.src: UAE Ministry of Finance, 29 Sep 2025; checked 12 Nov 2026. In-scope businesses.

lines.say: The Ministry of Finance says the issuer and the recipient both meet their obligations through the provider they appoint.
